column_semantics: The schedule has an Interest super-header split into separate Ref. Rate, Cash, and PIK columns. For floating-rate debt, the printed Ref. Rate such as S+ plus the Cash percentage is the cash leg; any PIK coupon is printed separately in the PIK column and is additive, not included in the Cash percentage. Rows with only a PIK percentage show a PIK-only stated rate in the PIK column.

rationale: The filing does not present a single all-in interest-rate column for these PIK positions. Instead, the Interest header is subdivided into Ref. Rate, Cash, and PIK, and multiple actual rows print a cash spread/rate and a separate PIK percentage in adjacent columns. Therefore the stated position-level cash rate/spread excludes PIK; PIK is quoted separately on top.
